title: Penplot — Generative Plotter Studio
description: Stack generative pen layers on real paper sizes, watch the plotter draw, export plotter-ready SVG.
concept: Penplot is a studio for pen-plotter art. Seven seeded generators — flow fields, marching-squares contours, hidden-line ridgelines, Truchet tiles, harmonographs, packed hatching and moire spirals — stack as up to six pen layers, each with its own ink, nib width and parameters. Everything is deterministic from a seed string, so any drawing can be reproduced or shared as a link. The preview animates the way a real plotter draws, path by path, with live pen-down distance and plot-time estimates.
features: 7 seeded generators, each with 4 tunable parameters
Up to 6 stackable pen layers with per-layer ink, nib width, reorder, hide and duplicate
6 paper sizes (A6-A3, square, postcard) with orientation and margin control
Animated plot-along preview with a travelling pen head and adjustable draw speed
6 built-in presets plus deterministic seed strings and per-layer reroll
Live pen-down distance and estimated plot time
Export plotter-ready SVG in millimetres, 200 dpi PNG, or a JSON project
Shareable URL hash, JSON project import, and localStorage autosave

interaction.mouse: Drag the sliders to reshape a layer; click a layer row to edit its pen.
interaction.click: Click the paper to reroll the selected layer; Plot replots, Reroll reseeds everything.
interaction.touch: Tap the sheet to reroll, scroll the panel for layers, pens, paper and export.
interaction.keyboard: Space replots, R rerolls the seed, S exports SVG, P exports PNG.
